turns.user: I step off the barge at Bluewatch.
turns.reply:
Rain needles the quay as Wessel steps ashore. A harbour clerk waves him toward the guild board.

<Changes>
~ time CY 611, Goldwane 12, 8:00 am
~ place Bluewatch | kind: settlement | region: Ersveil
+ present Marrit
~ weather cold drizzle
</Changes>

Among the notices, one is pinned with a fresh nail: the granary is overrun.

<Changes>
+ quest Granary Rats
</Changes>

Marrit stamps the slip. 'Six of them at least,' she says.

<Changes>
+ quest Granary Rats
</Changes>

turns.user: I head to the granary and look around.
turns.reply:
The smell hits first. Something skitters behind the sacks.

<Changes>
! time +1h
? check perception — spotting the nest | dc: normal | who: Wessel
</Changes>

turns.user: I draw my blade and go in.
turns.reply:
They boil out of the dark, a heaving carpet of teeth.

<Changes>
! encounter 6 Cellar Rat Swarm — pouring from the sacks | tier: weak | stakes: normal
</Changes>

Steel and boot leather do the work; the last of them flees into the drains.

<Changes>
! time +30m
</Changes>

Marrit counts the tails without comment and slides a purse across.

<Changes>
~ quest Granary Rats | progress: the nest is cleared | met: yes
- quest Granary Rats — done
</Changes>

turns.user: I buy a hot meal at the tavern.
turns.reply:
Fish stew, black bread, and a seat by the fire.

<Changes>
! time +1h
- coin 5 | to: tavern keeper
</Changes>

Wessel sleeps above the taproom while the rain keeps on.

<Changes>
! time +10h
</Changes>

turns.user: I wake and check my gear.
turns.reply:
Morning is grey and quiet; the blade needs oil.
